title: Dual adjunctions between enriched algebraic categories
summary: Working in the setting of enriched algebraic theories for a system of arities, we study several aspects of dual adjunctions between enriched algebraic categories, which we call algebraic dual adjunctions. Firstly, we generalize Freyd's theorem on contravariant algebra-valued right-adjoint functors to this setting. Secondly, we establish a biequivalence between a 2-category of algebraic dual adjunctions and a locally discrete 2-category of bifold algebras, in a sense defined in prior work of the author.
